Medicine MBChB at University of Manchester

What University of Manchester asks of applicants to Medicine MBChB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Manchester courses · Medicine field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 3 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US High School Diploma from an accredited US school: Manchester typically requires the equivalent of three A-levels plus GCSE English and Mathematics/Science
  • SAT I 1290 or ACT 27 is listed as one way to meet the GCSE-equivalent part (alternatively the High School Diploma with a minimum 3.0 and grade 12 classes at the GCSE grade equivalent)
  • SAT/ACT is not listed as meeting the A-level part — that is met with three AP tests or dual-enrolment/college-level classes in separate subjects, plus the High School Diploma (GPA 3.0)

University-wide guidance only; the Medicine course page says country-specific information is general only, that specific entry requirements may be different for Medicine, and asks applicants to contact ug.medicine@manchester.ac.uk.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: Information for students from the US · Manchester: MBChB Medicine (2027 entry)
English language
  • IELTS: minimum average 7.0, no component below 6.5, in the same sitting
  • PTE Academic: 65 overall with no less than 65 in each skill, same sitting
  • Cambridge C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency: 185 overall, no less than 185 in each domain
  • IB diploma: 5 in English at Standard or Higher Level
Verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: MBChB Medicine (2027 entry)
Admissions tests
  • UCAT — required, taken in the year of application (valid for one cycle)
  • Applicants in UCAT SJT Band 3 or 4 are not considered
Verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: MBChB Medicine (2027 entry)
Subject prerequisites
  • Required: Biology/Human Biology or Chemistry, plus one of Chemistry, Biology/Human Biology, Physics, Psychology, Mathematics or Further Mathematics

Biology/Human Biology or Chemistry is required, plus a second subject from a list — both are one-of choices the engine cannot hold, so no subject is matched; no preferred subject is stated.

IB requirements
Overall score
36 points
Details
666 at HL

36 points overall, 6,6,6 in Higher Level subjects; HL subjects must include Chemistry or Biology, plus another science (one of Chemistry, Biology, Physics, Psychology or Mathematics) and one further subject — one-of choices the engine cannot hold.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: MBChB Medicine (2027 entry)
Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement (US High School Diploma applicants, university-wide guide): AAA is typically met by three APs at 5,5,5 (or dual-enrolment/college-level classes) in separate subjects including any subject requirements, plus the High School Diploma with GPA 3.0
  • Medicine may set different country-specific requirements — contact ug.medicine@manchester.ac.uk

The AP equivalence is Manchester’s general table; the Medicine page says its specific requirements may differ and gives no AP subjects.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: Information for students from the US · Manchester: MBChB Medicine (2027 entry)
Other requirements
  • Interview required — no offers without interview; five-station multiple mini interview (MMI)
  • Relevant work experience required before applying (shadowing doctors not essential)
  • Satisfactory health screening and an Enhanced DBS check are non-academic offer conditions
